results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board | Business and Economy News | Al Jazeera
What Does the Fed's April Rate Decision Signal for 2026?
Fed meeting recap: Powell to stay on board - Trump's legal attacks have left me no choice

summary: April 29, 2026 FOMC: held rates steady at 3.5%-3.75%. Most dissents since Oct 1992 (4 total). Statement noted elevated inflation partly from rising global energy prices. Markets pricing no changes rest of 2026 and into 2027. Powell's final meeting as Fed Chair; staying on board. Stephen Miran (Trump appointee) dissented for immediate cut.
